name: Suite Life
source:
As part of the “SUITE LIFE” TV show, seven strangers began to live together in the same house. They all came from different backgrounds, but they must break down the walls that exist between them to become like family.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/10/17/october-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
